explanation: Propose one controlled RealNVP revision from scratch: reduce learning_rate from 0.001 to 0.0002 and hidden_dim from 64 to 32. Valid outputs nevertheless failed the marginal Wasserstein screen, while training NLL improved and validation NLL selected epoch 1. Slower updates and lower coupling-network capacity are testable responses to this pattern; improvement is uncertain. Preserve the panel, split, evaluation contract and acceptance criteria.

plan.objective_interpretation: Generate continuous log-dequantized PBMC3K expression on a small training-selected gene panel for exploratory statistical analysis; assess fit, marginal distributions, correlations, diversity and training overlap without claiming biological or downstream usefulness.
evidence: Raw 10x MTX input contains 2700 cells and 32738 genes, with no missing or infinite values; approximately 97.41% of entries are zero and 16104 features are constant.
No labels or existing splits are available. Preserve unconditional generation and the complete original random holdout split.
Previous validation output passed validity with 1000 finite, aligned 32-dimensional samples. This is separate from sample quality and utility.

continuous_feature_wasserstein was 0.319790 versus real-reference median 0.096676, ratio 3.307854, failing the existing screen. continuous_correlation_mae ratio 1.007367 and diversity ratio 1.038465 passed their screens. Recorded overlap diagnostics passed, with synthetic near fraction and exact duplicate fraction both zero; this is not a privacy guarantee.

fit_diagnostics observed nine epochs: train_nll decreased from 45.524153 to 41.723194, while validation_nll was best at epoch 1 (45.211610) and ended at 46.535739. Early stopping selected epoch 1; these are validation findings, not final-test results.

The remaining training allowance is 15 minutes. MPS is available; approximately 5.08 GB available memory at inspection is only a snapshot. The prior elapsed time is not a feasibility guarantee for the revision.

models.name: realnvp_flow
models.reason: Its implemented version 1.0 contract matches unconditional continuous log-dequantized generation, with analytic inversion and coupling networks for joint dependencies. Revise the existing candidate rather than divide the remaining exploratory budget among models.
models.hyperparameter_rationale: Change exactly two scientific settings: learning_rate 0.001 to 0.0002 and coupling-network hidden_dim 64 to 32. fit_diagnostics show train_nll falling from 45.524153 at epoch 1 to 41.723194 at epoch 9, but validation_nll selecting epoch 1 at 45.211610 and ending at 46.535739; its epoch-5-to-9 change was only -0.017088. Together with failed continuous_feature_wasserstein (ratio 3.307854), this motivates testing slower optimization and lower capacity. Predicted effect: less rapid training-specific fitting and potentially better validation-selected marginals. Competing explanations include limited flow expressiveness, dequantization-induced marginal structure or holdout variability; lower capacity could worsen fit, and lower learning rate could merely delay learning. Correlation and diversity screens already passed, so improvement must not come at their expense. Preserve the identical 32-gene training-selected panel and its ordering, six coupling layers, batch size 64, 60-epoch ceiling, patience 8, and 1000 generated samples to limit confounding. latent_dim=32 equals selected_features, with no dimension reduction. Start training from scratch; use Adam betas (0.9,0.999), float32 and gradient clipping 10. Select the lowest validation continuous NLL checkpoint. Apply deterministic per-cell Uniform[1e-6,1) jitter, log(count+U), and training-only mean/std; do not library-normalize. Train by continuous change-of-variables maximum likelihood, not ELBO. Reverse transforms analytically, undo standardization and save continuous log-expression without exponentiation or rounding. The 15-minute ceiling is not a runtime estimate; no executor pilot cap is assumed. Falling NLL alone cannot demonstrate sample quality or utility.

evaluation.success_criteria: Use explicit flow evaluation contract 1.0 for the continuous domain and evaluation contract 2.0 reference procedures and evidence policy. First require finite samples, expected 1000-by-32 shape, gene alignment and successful inversion; integer-count validity and zero-fraction checks do not apply. Record training and validation continuous NLL and select the checkpoint by validation NLL; NLL is not a count likelihood. Compare generated samples with equally transformed real cells using training-standardized mean marginal Wasserstein distance and correlation MAE on the selected 32 genes. Use equal-sized independently dequantized real references and ten fixed-seed reference draws, reporting medians and reference ranges, not confidence intervals. Apply the existing discrepancy screen of <=1.1 times median real-reference discrepancy with absolute tolerance 1e-8. Assess diversity with median pairwise Euclidean distances in standardized continuous log-expression coordinates and the existing held-out ratio screen 0.9..1.1. Assess overlap against a fixed training subset using its leave-one-out 1st-percentile near-distance threshold; report generated and held-out near rates and exact duplicate rates. Use matched sample sizes bounded by available held-out cells. A concrete statistical comparison is whether synthetic discrepancies meet these reference screens while diversity and overlap diagnostics remain recorded and interpretable; passing does not establish usefulness. Inspect validation NLL and these validation diagnostics before freezing the experiment. Inverse failures or nonfinite output fail the run and imply do_not_use; incomplete or budget-truncated evidence implies insufficient_evidence. Any controlled revision must use validation evidence, retain the test holdout and receive a separate budget. Evaluate the frozen final candidate on test once. No supervised utility or privacy conclusion is supported.

plan.downstream_use: Provisional exploratory statistical analysis of the selected gene panel only. No downstream utility was measured. Statistical similarity cannot establish biological usefulness; task-scoped use requires a separately measured, converged downstream comparison under evidence policy v2.
limitations: This revision is a proposal, not a training result. Prior findings came from validation; the final test remains reserved.
Compare revised and original validation NLL only with identical panel, preprocessing and data partition. Evaluate validity, model fit, sample quality and downstream utility separately.
Outputs are continuous log(count+uniform jitter) expression, not integer counts or normalized expression. Dequantization changes the target and removes exact zeros.
The 32-gene panel supports low-dimensional exploratory analysis only, not whole-transcriptome claims. No representation learning, conditioning or class balancing is supported by this flow.
The fit pattern suggests a testable optimization/capacity hypothesis, not a proven cause. Two simultaneous changes limit attribution between those settings.
Retain all original screens. If this revision fails and no further supported, testable change is justified within an explicit remaining allowance, stop rather than relax criteria.
Short-budget development evidence remains exploratory. Quality screens do not establish usability, biological benefit or privacy; no executor pilot caps are assumed.
Resource limits are monitored ceilings, not memory reservations or convergence guarantees.

objective.text: Generate continuous log-dequantized gene-expression profiles on a small selected-gene panel from PBMC3K for exploratory statistical analysis. Select compatible generative models and hyperparameters without a prespecified model. Evaluate output validity, model fit, marginal distributions, correlations, diversity and training overlap. Use recorded diagnostics and measured validation evidence for a controlled revision or stopping. Integer count generation is not required. Do not infer biological or downstream usefulness from statistical similarity alone.

image_vae.architecture: Two stride-2 convolutions, a hidden projection, diagonal-Gaussian encoder, transposed-convolution decoder.
image_vae.image_support: uint8 2D images with 1 or 3 channels; height and width divisible by 4, at most 64.
image_vae.likelihood: Fixed standard deviation 0.1 Gaussian on pixels scaled by 255; beta=1 ELBO.
image_vae.generation: Standard-normal latent, Gaussian decoder draws clipped to [0,1]; decoder means also saved separately.
image_vae.conditioning: One-hot class labels concatenated in encoder and decoder; balanced generation across observed classes.

count_vae.architecture: Two hidden layers, diagonal-Gaussian encoder, softmax proportions decoder, gene-wise learned dispersion.
count_vae.preprocessing: Training-only mean-binned standardized dispersion gene selection; raw count targets; log1p counts for encoder only.
count_vae.likelihood: Negative binomial with mean=selected-panel library size * decoded proportions; beta=1 ELBO.
count_vae.generation: Standard-normal latent; resample selected-panel library sizes from training cells (within class if conditional); gamma-Poisson draws on CPU.
count_vae.conditioning: Optional one-hot class labels in encoder and decoder; balanced generated classes.

image_gan.architecture: Latent/one-hot labels projected through two linear layers and two transposed convolutions with tanh; discriminator has two convolutions and two linear layers. No batch normalization.
image_gan.image_support: Same uint8 2D 1/3-channel image layouts as image VAE; scale to [-1,1].
image_gan.tasks: Generation and class balancing/augmentation only; no encoder or representation learning.
image_gan.likelihood: Implicit; no likelihood, reconstruction loss or ELBO is computed.
image_gan.optimizer: Separate Adam optimizers, both use plan learning_rate, betas (0.5,0.999); gradient norm clipping 10; float32. Overrides VAE defaults.
image_gan.training: One discriminator update with detached fake samples followed by one non-saturating generator update with discriminator parameters frozen; stable BCE-with-logits losses.
image_gan.conditioning: Optional one-hot labels in generator input and spatial label channels in discriminator. Fake training labels match each real batch; final generation cycles evenly across observed training classes.
image_gan.generation: Standard-normal latent passed through generator, tanh rescaled/rounded to uint8; no extra observation noise or decoder means.
image_gan.validation: Checkpoint/early stopping minimizes pooled-image feature Wasserstein distance on fixed up-to-512 training and validation subsets. Scaler fits training only; fixed latent draws match validation labels. Average aggregate discrepancy and per-class discrepancies when conditional. Same validation score each epoch, not adversarial loss or ELBO; not FID or proof of usefulness.

planar_flow.architecture: Standalone invertible data-to-standard-normal flow; learned diagonal affine transform followed by flow_layers transforms. No VAE.
planar_flow.preprocessing: Select 2..128 genes using training-only dispersion ranking. Deterministic per-cell uniform dequantization, log(count+U), then training-only mean/std. No library normalization. latent_dim equals selected_features.
planar_flow.training: Exact change-of-variables density of standardized continuous coordinates; Adam betas (0.9,0.999), gradient clip 10. Validation NLL selects best checkpoint and patience. This is not an integer count likelihood or ELBO.
planar_flow.generation: Normal latent, reverse transforms; planar uses 64-step monotone bisection and checks inverse residual, radial and affine coupling use analytic inverses. Undo training standardization; save continuous log-expression samples without rounding or exponentiation.
planar_flow.tasks: Unconditional data_generation only. Coupling hidden_dim sets MLP width; planar/radial hidden_dim=16 is an unused schema placeholder.

evaluation_contract.validity: Finite samples, exact expected shape, image uint8 range or nonnegative integer counts, label/gene alignment.

distribution_fidelity.image: Mean marginal Wasserstein distance in training-fitted standardized 4x4 pooled pixel/channel-variation features; includes per-class checks when labels exist. Not FID or a biological/perceptual score.
distribution_fidelity.counts: Mean absolute differences in log1p gene means, log1p gene variances, zero fractions, log1p panel-total Wasserstein distance, and correlations among up to 64 training-variable genes.
distribution_fidelity.reference: Equal-sized training resampling and held-out real observations, ten fixed-seed reference draws; report median and reference range, not a confidence interval.
distribution_fidelity.screen: Synthetic discrepancy <= 1.1 times median real-reference discrepancy, with absolute tolerance 1e-8. A heuristic screen, not a calibrated scientific acceptance guarantee.

evaluation_contract.diversity: Median pairwise Euclidean distance in training-standardized pooled-image/log1p-count features; compare to equal-sized held-out samples; ratio screen 0.9..1.1.
evaluation_contract.nearest_neighbor_overlap: Nearest distances to a fixed training subset; near threshold is its leave-one-out 1st percentile. Report synthetic and held-out rates, plus exact duplicate rates against the same training subset. No privacy guarantee.
evaluation_contract.real_test_macro_f1: Real-only vs real+synthetic fixed C=1 logistic regression on training-fitted pooled-image features. Validation mode computes a validation proxy; only final mode computes test scores. Include class-matched real-resampling augmentation control.
evaluation_contract.per_class_recall: Recall on the same held-out observations with fixed training-class vocabulary; paired, class-stratified bootstrap for macro-F1 differences.
evaluation_contract.heldout_representation_quality: Frozen unconditional VAE posterior means vs training-fitted PCA at the same latent dimension; training-standardized embeddings with identical logistic probes and held-out labels. Unlabeled data are explicitly unsupported for this utility test.
evaluation_contract.decision_rules: Evidence policy v2: invalid output do_not_use; pilots, validation and incomplete evidence insufficient_evidence. No conjunction of quality thresholds establishes usability. Frozen converged task comparison with positive paired interval (and positive comparison against resampling for augmentation) supports task-scoped limited_use; a negative interval supports task-scoped do_not_use. Otherwise insufficient_evidence. No absolute F1 improvement threshold. Generation without a measured downstream task cannot establish biological usefulness.
evaluation_contract.image_assessment: Supplementary joint empirical energy distances in training-standardized local-gradient mean/std and training-only pixel PCA (up to 32 components); reference draws and conditional bootstrap intervals, without cutoffs. Fixed-seed per-class real/generated visual packets record source indices and explicit review status. Not FID or a validated histology score.
evaluation_contract.utility_gate: Legacy descriptive flag only, not the recommendation gate: Macro-F1 improvement >=0.01, paired 95% bootstrap lower bound >0, and no class recall loss >0.02; all arms converged. Representation compares VAE to PCA.
